([[Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]]) | college = *[[Penn State Nittany Lions basketball|Penn State]] (2019–2023) | highlights = }} '''Seth Lundy''' (born April 2, 2000) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Penn State Nittany Lions basketball|Penn State Nittany Lions]] of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. ==Early life and high school== Lundy grew up in [[Paulsboro, New Jersey]] and attended [[Roman Catholic High School]] in [[Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]].{{cite web|url=https://www.app.com/story/sports/college/2023/03/14/march-madness-top-12-new-jerseyans-to-watch-in-the-ncaa-tournament/70003303007/|title=March Madness: Top 10 New Jerseyans to watch in the NCAA Tournament, ranked|work=[[Asbury Park Press]]|date=March 14, 2023|access-date=June 5, 2023}} He averaged 16.4 points and 8.7 rebounds per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://www.pennlive.com/highschoolsports/article/roman-catholic-basketball-star-seth-lundy-picks-up-sec-offer/|title=Roman Catholic basketball star Seth Lundy picks up SEC offer|work=[[The Patriot-News]]|date=April 26, 2018|access-date=June 5, 2023}} Lundy committed to play college basketball at Penn State over offers from [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]], [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]], and [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]].{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/philly/sports/high_school/pennsylvania/seth-lundy-penn-state-basketball-commitment-recruiting-roman-catholic-high-school-20181005.html|title=Seth Lundy joins Roman Catholic basketball pipeline to Penn State|first=Rick|last=O'Brien|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=October 5, 2018|access-date=June 5, 2023}} ==College career== Lundy averaged 5.3 points per game during his freshman season at Penn State.{{cite web|url=https://www.dailyitem.com/sports/lundy-to-declare-for-nba-draft-pair-enters-transfer-portal/article_57e2b56a-c915-11ed-ad34-4f77ffe5da08.html|title=Lundy to declare for NBA Draft; Pair enters transfer portal|work=[[The Daily Item (Sunbury)|The Daily Item]]|date=March 22, 2023|access-date=June 5, 2023}} He averaged 10.1 points and 4.2 rebounds over 25 games with 15 starts as a sophomore. After the season Lundy entered the NCAA transfer portal, but ultimately withdrew and returned to Penn State.{{cite web|url=https://www.pennlive.com/pennstatefootball/2021/04/penn-state-mens-basketball-forward-seth-lundy-leaves-transfer-portal-report.html|title=Penn State men’s basketball forward Seth Lundy leaves transfer portal: report|work=[[The Patriot-News]]|date=April 15, 2021|access-date=June 5, 2023}} He started all 30 of the Nittany Lions' games during his junior season and averaged 11.9 points and 4.9 rebounds while leading the team with 20 total blocked shots.{{cite web|url=https://apnews.com/article/sports-jalen-pickett-seth-lundy-micah-shrewsberry-college-basketball-4298930472ad4897f5da4788fc9955ad|title=Shrewsberry hopes Penn State takes a step forward in Year 2|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=October 19, 2022|access-date=June 5, 2023}} Lundy was named honorable mention All-[[Big Ten Conference]] as a senior after averaging 14.2 points and 6.3 rebounds per game.{{cite web|url=https://nittanylionswire.usatoday.com/2023/05/02/jalen-pickett-and-seth-lundy-invited-to-nba-combine/|title=Jalen Pickett and Seth Lundy invited to NBA combine|first=Kevin|last=McGuire|website=Nittany Lions Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=May 2, 2023|access-date=June 5, 2023}} After the season he declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/penn-state/seth-lundy-nba-draft-penn-state-ncaa-mens-basketball-20230322.html|title=Penn State and former Roman guard Seth Lundy declaring for NBA
